components.css: .ds-categories{display:flex;gap:21px;align-items:center;padding:0 20px 4px;min-height:44px;background:#25312a}.ds-categories button{font:11px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;position:relative;border:0;padding:8px 0;min-height:40px;background:transparent;color:#ffffffbe;cursor:pointer;transition:color .18s,transform .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-categories button:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:-3px -8px}.ds-categories button[aria-pressed=true]{color:#fff;font-weight:600}.ds-categories button[aria-pressed=true]:after{content:'';position:absolute;width:13px;height:2px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--yellow,#ffe335);bottom:0;left:calc(50% - 6.5px)}.ds-categories button:hover{color:var(--yellow,#ffe335)}.ds-categories button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #9bc5ed;outline-offset:4px}.ds-categories button:active{transform:scale(.96)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-categories button{transition:none}}

narrative.overview: The photograph supplies both the focal image and the blurred surrounding atmosphere. Compact controls sit beneath it; dark round tools, small image thumbnails and a saturated yellow export action carry the pinned Prisma vocabulary. This records only the built concept in this directory. It does not establish a global Huevia identity or a production Android implementation.
keyCharacteristics: Circular dark tools with inline SVG line icons.
Direct original/effect comparison and new-copy JPEG export.

rules.name: The Photo Atmosphere Rule
rules.body: Derive the editor backdrop from the active photograph; retain the dark overlay that separates controls from its colors.

dos: Do preserve the photo-first hierarchy and its image-derived backdrop.
Do pair selected color with a check, underline or visible control state.
Do keep original/effect labels clear of the compare control and retain the movable seam.
Do label demonstration behavior honestly and preserve new-copy export.
donts: Don't promote this bounded concept into the native app's global design system.
Don't treat CSS looks, illustrative imagery or portrait controls as production processing claims.
Don't present the scoped review or detector fallback as comprehensive accessibility or native acceptance certification.
